lines.text: Netflix taught AI to find slow code in its own services.
Before, experts read flame graphs by hand. Now an AI reads the data for them.
lines.title: Finding slow code

lines.text: The agent profiles a live service and looks only at Netflix's own code.
lines.title: The pipeline

lines.text: One text-matching pattern used 46 percent of a service's CPU. A lookup table made it 22 times faster.
lines.title: Regex on the hot path

lines.text: Another service spent 66 percent of its CPU looking up a counter, while real work used 0.3 percent.
lines.title: Counter lookups

lines.text: Every fix is tested on a small canary copy, then a human reviews it.
lines.title: Safety first

lines.text: Good known patterns are saved in Git, so no team repeats the same hunt.
